scope: Bounded primary-source checks; no global novelty claim. No result is established by a citation alone.

references.title: Recursiveness, positivity, and truncated moment problems
references.use: Primary moment positivity and recursion precedent.

references.use: Matrix-exponential perturbation background; D081–D087 use elementary integral and series proofs.

references.title: Splitting methods for differential equations
references.use: Primary author survey for Lie–Trotter and Strang attribution; our stated finite matrix estimates are proved explicitly.
